description: Replace the whole topology in one call. Atomic: if any device, link, IOS block or host IP entry is invalid, nothing changes and the error names the failing item. Same rules as add_device, add_link, configure_device and configure_pc (models are resolved, ports normalized, cables inferred when omitted, IOS commands run in global configuration mode).

model.description: PTBuilder model key, e.g. 2911, 2960-24TT, PC-PT. Aliases such as "4331", "WRT300N" or "PC" are resolved.

name.description: Unique device name, e.g. R1, S1, PC1: 1-64 characters: letters, digits, spaces and . _ ( ) / -, starting with a letter or digit. Names are case-insensitive.

x.description: X coordinate on the Packet Tracer logical workspace, -100000 to 100000. Omit both x and y for automatic placement.

y.description: Y coordinate on the Packet Tracer logical workspace, -100000 to 100000. Omit both x and y for automatic placement.

ios.description: IOS commands per router/switch (global configuration mode).

commands.description: IOS commands in global configuration mode, one per item, e.g. ["hostname R1", "interface GigabitEthernet0/0", "ip address 192.168.1.1 255.255.255.0", "no shutdown", "exit"]. At most 2000 items of 512 characters; a device keeps at most 2000 commands.

name.description: Device name, e.g. R1, S1, PC1 (case-insensitive).

cable.description: Cable type. Omit it to let the server infer the right one (recommended). "auto" is passed to PT as-is and its behaviour is unverified.

dev1.description: Device name, e.g. R1, S1, PC1 (case-insensitive).

dev2.description: Device name, e.g. R1, S1, PC1 (case-insensitive).

port1.description: Interface name, e.g. GigabitEthernet0/0, FastEthernet0/1, FastEthernet0 (abbreviations such as Gi0/0 are expanded).

port2.description: Interface name, e.g. GigabitEthernet0/0, FastEthernet0/1, FastEthernet0 (abbreviations such as Gi0/0 are expanded).

dhcp.description: true = obtain the address by DHCP (ip/mask/gateway are ignored).

dns.description: DNS server IPv4 address (kept with DHCP too).

ip.description: IPv4 address, e.g. 192.168.1.10 (or 192.168.1.10/24 to include the mask).

name.description: Device name, e.g. R1, S1, PC1 (case-insensitive).

name: build_topology
title: Build topology
